live.offline: Offline: reload to see the latest

step.requestedWords: Asked when the customer accepted the quote ({date})
step.pageNotSent: Not sent yet: the customer finds the IBAN, the amount and the reference on it
step.invoiceNotNeeded: Not needed: this deposit is only a payment
step.invoiceWaits: Waits to be issued by finance
step.sdiAfterInvoice: Sent once the TD02 is issued
step.sdiNoRight: The SDI state is shown to people who see invoices

none.title: No deposit asked
none.body: This order needs no deposit: production may start when its work orders are released.
none.missing: The order needs a deposit, but no request exists: it is asked when the quote is accepted.

noMatch.title: No orders match
noMatch.body: Change the search or the rows, or clear the filters.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Orders appear here when a customer accepts a quote, or when the office types one with New order.

board.label: Orders by state
board.offBoard: Not on the board: {closed} closed, {cancelled} cancelled.

notOnBoard.title: Closed and cancelled orders are not on the board
notOnBoard.body: The board shows the orders still moving. These are in the list.

board.newTabHint: Leave it open on a second screen: it follows every change by itself.

record.title: Order

not_found.title: This order does not exist
not_found.body: It may belong to another company, or the address is wrong.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this order
forbidden.body: Orders open to people with a sales, finance or production role over its company and customer.

record.dockHint: The order's thread beside the tab
record.closed: Closed on {date}: nothing on it changes any more.
record.closedNoDate: Closed: nothing on it changes any more.
record.readOnly: Read-only: your role follows orders and changes none.
record.noPanels: The thread, files and history open with the record.
record.reapproval: Waiting for the customer to accept the change

held.noWorkOrders: Making work orders needs the production manager's right
held.depositMissing: Production waits for a deposit that was never asked
held.noManage: Changing an order needs the sales right to manage orders
held.closeState: Only a shipped order is closed
held.noClose: Closing needs the right to manage or close orders
held.notSettled: Not settled yet: closing it anyway needs the right to close unsettled orders
held.cancelState: Only an order that has not shipped anything is cancelled: a return is the way back
held.cancelWorkOrders: Its lines have work orders: cancel the drafts first; a released one keeps the order
held.readyState: Only an order in production is marked ready
held.final: A closed or cancelled order never changes
held.noPayments: Recording payments needs the finance right
held.depositNotOpen: Nothing is left to pay on this deposit
held.noQuote: This deposit belongs to no quote: its page goes with the quote
held.noPrice: Amounts are shown to people who see prices
held.noIssue: Sending to SDI needs the right to issue invoices
held.sdiNotNow: It cannot be sent now: see its state
held.amending: The lines are being amended: review or discard the amendment first
held.amendShipped: Its lines are fixed once anything shipped: a later change is a return
held.amendMtm: This order has a made-to-measure unit: it is not amended here yet
held.amendState: This order takes no amendment now
held.closeLinesState: Only an order that is not fully shipped closes lines
held.closeLinesNone: Nothing is left to close: every line shipped in full or is closed already
held.closeLinesOnly: Nothing has shipped and this is the only open line: cancel the order instead
held.reopenState: A closed or cancelled order keeps its closed lines
held.noQuotes: Making quotes needs the sales right to manage quotes

summary.label: The order at a glance
summary.title: Summary
summary.noPrice: Shown to people who see prices
summary.marginUnknown: Not known: a cost is missing

chain.title: From the quote to the invoices

gate.title: Deposit gate
gate.paid: Deposit paid on {date}: production may start.
gate.missing: The order needs a deposit, but none was asked: production waits.
gate.notNeeded: No deposit needed: production may start.

lines.readOnly: What the customer ordered, as accepted. The lines change only through an amendment (Amend order).
lines.noRevision: Revision chosen by the work order
lines.madeHint: Pieces made per size are counted on each work order (Production tab).

dates.title: Dates
dates.neverBody: The promise is still the one given when the order was made.

production.title: Work orders

empty.title: No work orders yet
empty.body: Production makes work orders from the order's lines once the deposit allows it.

production.noProgressRight: Floor progress is shown to people who follow production.

ship.gridCaption: {style}: pieces left to ship by colour and size

empty.title: Nothing shipped yet
empty.body: Shipments made in the warehouse for this order appear here.

noInvoices.title: Nothing invoiced yet
noInvoices.body: The deposit invoice and the invoices of shipped goods appear here.

money.noInvoiceRight: Invoices are shown to people who see invoices.

next.WAIT: SDI answers within a few days.
next.FIX_AND_RESEND: Fix it and send it again (Invoices).
next.CHECK_COPY: In the customer's tax drawer; a copy went by e-mail.

link.REVOKED: Sent to {to} on {date} · replaced by a newer page
link.USED_UP: Sent to {to} on {date} · opened as often as it may
link.title: Send the bank-details page
link.body: The customer gets an e-mail with a link to a page that shows the amount, the due date, the reference to write on the transfer and the company's bank account.
link.replaces: A page sent before stops opening: the new one replaces it.
link.messageHint: Added to the e-mail above the link.
link.sentTo: Sent to {to}: the page opens until {until}.
link.sentFailed: The page was made for {to}, but the e-mail did not leave: send it again.

payment.title: Record the deposit payment · {number}
payment.body: Type the bank transfer as it reached the account. It is placed on this deposit, never more than it still asks.
payment.referenceHint: As the bank statement shows it; one reference is recorded once.
payment.issueHint: The TD02 gets its number now; your authenticator code is asked.
payment.issueOff: The payment is recorded; the TD02 waits to be issued.
payment.issueByFinance: The TD02 that follows is issued by a person with the right to issue invoices.
payment.noInvoice: No deposit invoice follows this deposit (its VAT rule).
payment.over: More than is left: {left} goes on the deposit, the rest stays on the payment.
payment.doneFull: {amount} recorded ({reference}): the deposit is paid and production may start.
payment.donePart: {amount} recorded ({reference}): part of the deposit is still to pay.
payment.td02FilesPending: Deposit invoice {number} issued; its files are still being made.
payment.td02Later: The deposit invoice (TD02) waits to be issued.

problem.amount: Type an amount above zero, e.g. 1872,00
problem.future: A payment is recorded once it arrived

sdiSend.title: Send {number} to SDI
sdiSend.body: The deposit invoice of {date} goes to the Exchange System, which delivers it to the customer. It cannot be changed after.

promise.title: Change the promise of {number}
promise.scopeOrderHint: Every line without a date of its own
promise.dateHint: From today on. The first promise stays on record.
promise.tellCustomer: Tell the customer in the order's thread (Activity).

problem.past: A new promise is a day from today on

ready.title: Mark {number} ready to ship
ready.body: While quality release is not used for this order, a person says it is ready, with the reason.

close.title: Close {number}
close.settled: Every line is shipped, invoiced and paid.
close.reasonNeeded: Say why it closes before it is settled

settlement.NOT_INVOICED: Shipped goods are not invoiced yet.
settlement.OVER_INVOICED: More is invoiced than shipped: a credit note corrects it.
settlement.AT_SDI: An invoice is not delivered by SDI yet.
settlement.DEPOSIT_NOT_DEDUCTED: A deposit invoice is not deducted in full.
settlement.DEPOSIT_NOT_INVOICED: A deposit paid has no deposit invoice yet.
settlement.BALANCE_DUE: The invoices are not paid in full.
settlement.REFUND_DUE: A refund is due to the customer.

noQuote.title: Typed by the office — no quote
noQuote.body: This order did not come from an accepted quote.

docs.noQuoteRight: From quote {number} v{revision}. Its evidence is shown to people who see quotes.
docs.noEvidence: Quote {number} v{revision} has no acceptance evidence on record.
docs.filesBody: The order's files — the customer's PO, copies, anything added — are in Activity › Files, with who can see each.

notice.promise: The promise date changed; the first promise stays on record.
notice.ready: The order is ready to ship.
notice.sdiSent: Sent to SDI: its answer appears here when it comes.
notice.amendedReaccept: Amendment {revision} applied. The net total changed: the customer must accept the order again — tell them.

sentence.td02: Issuing the deposit invoice gives it its number for good. Type the code from your authenticator app.
sentence.sdi: Sending an invoice to SDI cannot be undone. Type the code from your authenticator app.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or was used already. Type the newest one.
problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a minute and try again.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked now. Try again.

read.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not open this.
read.not_found: It is not there any more.
read.unavailable: The factory server is not answering: check the connection and try again.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
read.internal: Something went wrong on the server.

write.moved: Someone changed this order meanwhile: it was read again, check it and try once more.
write.state: The order moved on meanwhile: it was read again.
write.reference: This bank reference was recorded already: check the statement.
write.invalid: Something typed is not accepted: check the fields.
write.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
write.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
write.not_found: It is not there any more.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The factory server is not answering: nothing was changed.
write.internal: Something went wrong on the server: nothing was changed.

amend.title: Amendment {revision} — not applied
amend.how: Change the sizes and prices below, add a colour or a style, or set a line to 0 to remove it. Nothing changes until you review and apply the amendment.
amend.reading: Checking the amendment with the factory server…
amend.failed: The amendment could not be checked.
amend.reaccept: The net total changes: the customer must accept the order again. The order shows “waiting for the customer”; the acceptance link is not there yet, so tell the customer yourself.
amend.noReaccept: The net total does not change: the customer does not need to accept again.
amend.reasonHint: It stays with the amendment, in the Changes tab.

held.price: A typed price is not a price: check it
held.workOrders: A size is below what work orders already make
held.empty: An order keeps at least one line: to stop the whole order, cancel it
held.problems: Fix what stops the amendment first

add.title: Add a style
add.styleHint: Type its code or name, pick it, then the colours to add: their rows open in its grid.

empty.title: No lines yet
empty.amend: Add a style above: an order keeps at least one line.
empty.new: Add a style above, pick its colours and type the pieces per size.

editor.gridCaption: Pieces of {style} by colour and size
editor.styleUnread: The style could not be read: only its sizes on the order
editor.lockedClosed_one: {colour}: closed short ({count} piece): reopen it first to change it
editor.lockedClosed_other: {colour}: closed short ({count} pieces): reopen it first to change it
editor.lockedMtm: {colour}: a made-to-measure unit, kept as it is

issue.state: The order does not take this change in its state now.
issue.lines: A line that work orders make, closed short, or that a shipment or invoice names cannot be removed: close it short or lower its sizes instead.
issue.party: This customer cannot take an order now (not active, or no customer role).
issue.contact: The contact is not an active contact of this customer.
issue.billTo: The customer has no invoice address in force: add one to the customer first.
issue.shipTo: The customer has no delivery address in force: add one to the customer first.
issue.promiseDate: The promise date is today or later.
issue.requestedDate: The requested date is today or later.
issue.customerRef: The customer PO is too long.
issue.deposit: The deposit is above 0 and at most 100 percent, or none.
issue.number: The company has no number series for orders: an administrator adds one under Numbering.
issue.terms: The payment terms are not in force.
issue.other: Something is not accepted: check the order.

line.sizes: {line}: check its sizes (a size not offered for this colour, or below what work orders make).
line.price: {line}: type its unit price (no price list prices it for this customer).
line.catalogue: {line}: this style or colour cannot be ordered now (archived, or not offered).
line.moved: {line}: the order changed meanwhile: read it again.

closeLines.title: Close remaining lines of {number}
closeLines.body: What is left of these lines will not be made or shipped. What shipped stays as it is.
closeLines.pieces_one: {count} piece will not be made or shipped.
closeLines.pieces_other: {count} pieces will not be made or shipped.
closeLines.inWorkOrders_one: Work orders still make {count} piece of these lines: Production decides whether to finish it into stock.
closeLines.inWorkOrders_other: Work orders still make {count} pieces of these lines: Production decides whether to finish them into stock.
closeLines.reasonHint: For example: the customer does not want the rest.
closeLines.reversal: You can reopen closed lines later (Reopen lines).
closeLines.done_one: {count} line closed ({pieces} pieces will not be made or shipped).
closeLines.done_other: {count} lines closed ({pieces} pieces will not be made or shipped).
closeLines.stillMade_one: Work orders still make {count} piece of them: Production decides.
closeLines.stillMade_other: Work orders still make {count} pieces of them: Production decides.

problem.all: Nothing has shipped: closing every line would leave an empty order. Cancel the order instead

reopen.title: Reopen lines of {number}
reopen.body: The pieces closed short are made and shipped again.

cancel.title: Cancel order {number}
cancel.reading: Checking what the cancellation would touch…
cancel.failed: What the cancellation would touch could not be read: {problem}
cancel.blocked: This order cannot be cancelled yet: first deal with what stops it.
cancel.leavesTitle: What it leaves behind (the people who own it decide)
cancel.reasonHint: It stays on the order and in its history.
cancel.type: Type the order number {number} to confirm
cancel.typeWrong: This is not the order's number.
cancel.reversal: There is no way back: a cancelled order stays as it is. To start again, copy it as a new quote.

held.reading: Checking what the cancellation would touch first
held.blocked: Something stops the cancellation: see above

impact.STATE_final: The order is closed or cancelled: it never changes.
impact.STATE_shipped: Goods left: a shipped order is not cancelled (a return or a credit note is the way back).
impact.DRAFT_WORK_ORDERS: Its draft work orders are cancelled first in Production ({refs}).
impact.SHIPMENT_IN_PREPARATION: Shipments being packed for it are cancelled first in the warehouse ({refs}).
impact.SHIPPED: Goods left with {refs}: a shipped order is not cancelled (a return is the way back).
impact.INVOICE_DRAFT_one: A draft invoice of the order is removed first in Finance.
impact.INVOICE_DRAFT_other: {count} draft invoices of the order are removed first in Finance.
impact.INVOICE_ISSUED: Invoices of the order were issued ({refs}): a fiscal document is never deleted; Finance issues a credit note first.
impact.DEPOSITS_CANCELLED_one: The deposit not paid yet is cancelled with the order: the customer is no longer asked for it.
impact.DEPOSITS_CANCELLED_other: {count} deposits not paid yet are cancelled with the order: the customer is no longer asked for them.
impact.PAYMENT_STEPS_CANCELLED_one: {count} open step of the payment schedule is cancelled.
impact.PAYMENT_STEPS_CANCELLED_other: {count} open steps of the payment schedule are cancelled.
impact.WORK_ORDERS_OPEN: Work orders stay open ({refs}): Production finishes them into stock or cancels them.
impact.LEATHER_CUT_one: Leather was already cut for it: {count} hide on {refs}.
impact.LEATHER_CUT_other: Leather was already cut for it: {count} hides on {refs}.
impact.STOCK_RESERVED_one: {count} reservation of stock stays until the planner releases it.
impact.STOCK_RESERVED_other: {count} reservations of stock stay until the planner releases them.
impact.PURCHASE_ORDERS: Planning counted on purchase orders for it ({refs}): they stay open; the buyer decides.
impact.DEPOSIT_PAID: The deposit was paid: it stays; a refund is Finance's.
impact.DEPOSIT_PAID_invoiced: The deposit was paid and invoiced ({refs}): it stays; a refund or a credit note is Finance's.
impact.PAYMENT_STEPS_PAID_one: {count} paid step of the payment schedule stays paid: a refund is Finance's.
impact.PAYMENT_STEPS_PAID_other: {count} paid steps of the payment schedule stay paid: a refund is Finance's.

copy.title: Copy {number} as a new quote
copy.body: A new draft quote for {customer} with this order's lines.
copy.prices: A line sold at the list price takes today's list price; a price typed by hand stays.
copy.left: Styles, colours or sizes no longer offered are left out (counted after the copy).
copy.dropped_one: {count} line or size was left out (no longer offered).
copy.dropped_other: {count} lines or sizes were left out (no longer offered).

schedule.title: Payment schedule
schedule.label: Payment steps
schedule.empty: Paid on invoice terms; no milestones.

when.DEPOSIT: Due as the deposit request says

schedule.cancelled_one: {count} earlier step was replaced when an amendment remade the schedule.
schedule.cancelled_other: {count} earlier steps were replaced when an amendment remade the schedule.

held.goodsLeft: Goods have left already: the balance goes on the goods’ invoice.
held.noInvoice: Invoicing a step needs the right to manage invoices.
held.noManage: Opening a step needs the right to manage orders.

verbs.openBody: Its payment request is made now: it is paid like the deposit, and its deposit invoice (TD02) follows the payment (DPR 633/1972 art. 6 c.4).
verbs.opened: The step is open for payment.

problem.day: Choose the day it falls due.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.moved: The schedule changed meanwhile: read it again.
problem.state: Not now: nothing paid waits for an invoice, or the step changed.
problem.write: It could not be done: try again.

changes.title: Amendments
changes.subtitle: Each change to the confirmed order, numbered, with the order before and after.

empty.title: No changes since confirmation
empty.body: An amendment appears here once it is applied (Lines › Amend order).
empty.final: The order never changed after its confirmation.

changes.waiting: Waiting for the customer to accept the changed order (since {date}). The acceptance link is not there yet: tell the customer yourself.

compare.title: Revision {revision} of {number}: before → after
compare.tableLabel: The order's lines before and after
compare.noSnapshot: The frozen snapshot is not available: the sizes come from the change itself.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.body: Typed by the office (for example an order by phone or e-mail). Its lines are typed next; nothing is saved until Confirm order.
newOrder.customerHint: Name, code, VAT number or tax code.
newOrder.warnings_one: The customer has {count} warning: see their record.
newOrder.warnings_other: The customer has {count} warnings: see their record.
newOrder.contactHint: The orders contact is picked when there is one.
newOrder.customerRefHint: Their order number, printed on the documents.
newOrder.numberUnknown: The number is given when the order is confirmed.
newOrder.number: It will get number {number} (unless another order takes it first).

held.party: This customer is {status}: no order is taken from them
held.identity: This customer has no tax identity in force: add it to the customer first
held.lines: Add a line with at least one piece
held.previewFailed: The order could not be priced: try again
held.problems: Fix what the summary lists first

missing.title: No customer chosen
missing.body: Start a new order from the orders list: the dialog asks the customer first.

error.title: The customer could not be read

newOrder.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until Confirm order: the lines stay in this tab, even if it reloads. Confirm makes the order confirmed at once, with its deposit request.
newOrder.promiseHint: Today or later; empty: given later.
newOrder.scheduleLater: The steps show once the order is priced.

problem.past: A date is today or later.
